Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building and classroom data with square footage and site plans (Appendices B-F). Robust condition assessment using Facility Inspection Tool with detailed category ratings and overall 'Good' condition rating districtwide (Section III, Tables III-2 and III-3). Connects condition data to maintenance planning and capital needs (Section VI).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections through 2029/30 with methodology and assumptions explained (Section IV, Table IV-1). Capacity utilization data by site and classroom with practical capacity calculations and connection to facility actions such as grade reconfiguration (Section II, Table II-3). Discusses implications of declining enrollment and facility adaptation strategies.

Educational Alignment.justification: Includes detailed educational program overview, district mission, vision, and LCAP goals linking educational priorities to facilities (Section I). Mentions specific programs like STEAM, intervention, and special education but connections to facility projects are partial and not fully developed.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: References to outdoor spaces such as playfields, hardcourts, and landscaping are present with some mention of improvements (Section VI project lists). However, lacks districtwide data or comprehensive greening strategies, and minimal discussion of environmental or health benefits or outdoor learning.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges wildfire risk and disaster preparedness with references to safety plans and collaboration with emergency services (Section V). Includes some mitigation strategies like tree assessment and removal for fire hazard (Section VI project lists). Does not provide comprehensive climate risk assessment or multi-hazard strategies.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions energy-related projects such as HVAC upgrades and backup generators in project lists (Section VI). No detailed energy use data or comprehensive strategy for electrification, decarbonization, or resilience. No explicit reference to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Provides preliminary cost estimates for projects with contingencies and escalation assumptions (Appendix G). Describes multiple funding sources including state programs, bonds, and local options (Section VII). Includes project prioritization recommendations but lacks a fully detailed long-term financial plan or comprehensive prioritization framework.
